_comment: FICTIONAL sample campaign brief — what the host agent produces from the insight payload, and what the marketer sees. Made-up brand (Northwind Athletic); invented figures.

meta.objective: Launch a social campaign that taps the current trending topics, stories and cultural moments in trail running.

strategicSummary: The US trail conversation is being reshaped by first-timers and a values-led 'slow trail' movement — and this audience engages with beginner honesty far more than podium coverage. Northwind should own the on-ramp: a community campaign that makes the first trail 50K feel achievable, welcoming and un-intimidating, riding the spring race-season peak.

insightFoundation.insight: Beginner/first-timer content out-engages elite race coverage for women 25–44.
insightFoundation.soWhat: Point the campaign at the on-ramp, not the podium.

insightFoundation.insight: 'Slow trail' / no-watch running is rising fast and under-claimed by big brands.
insightFoundation.soWhat: A values-led lane Northwind can credibly enter via its minimalist story.

insightFoundation.insight: Spring 50K season peaks in the next 4–6 weeks with record women's entries.
insightFoundation.soWhat: A live cultural moment to launch against — urgency is built in.

concepts.name: First Mile Club
concepts.bigIdea: A creator-led series following real first-timers from couch to their first trail 50K, with Northwind as the quiet enabler — kit, not ego.
concepts.why: Turns beginner honesty (the highest-engaging content for this audience) into a repeatable, ownable franchise.
concepts.groundedIn: Whitespace: 'champion the first-timer' + Spring 50K season moment

formats.idea: Carousel: 'what nobody tells you about your first trail race'

concepts.name: Leave It Better
concepts.bigIdea: Northwind-sponsored weekend cleanup runs — purpose-led community miles that blend fitness and environment.
concepts.why: Purpose-led runs show high share rates; community framing beats solo-hero for this audience.
concepts.groundedIn: Cultural moment: 'trail cleanup' community runs + community-first resonance

formats.idea: Partner with @trailsisters chapters to host cleanup runs
'Slow trail' device-free run edits from cleanup days

channelPlan.role: Discovery + the 'slow trail' aesthetic; home of the diaries
Convert engaged first-timers into the beginner trail line

timingHook: Launch against the spring 50K season peak in the next 4–6 weeks, when first-timer intake and 'can I do this?' searching are at their annual high.
watchouts: Stay the enabler, not the hero — over-branding the diaries would break the beginner-honesty that makes them work.
'Slow trail' is values-led; a purely performance-gear message would read as co-opting the movement.
